evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: The owned/rented opposition frames self-origination and possession of capability as the appealed-to good, placing autonomy and self-enhancement in direct value language.

evidence.quote: the perspective is the asset you keep.

observations.why: Calling perspective an asset to keep appeals to self-origination and durable personal standing as the value retained beyond commodity substrates.
